reforms.description: Canada introduced a new programme for the advancement of industrial technology, which has been well received by industry with commitments and outlays proceeding according to official forecasts.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: Direct support for industrial technology development enhances firm-level innovation capacity and technological upgrading, raising productivity and competitiveness.
reforms.status_evidence: The text states the programme 'has been well received by industry and the rate of commitments and outlays has been in accordance with official forecasts,' indicating active implementation.
reforms.importance_rationale: A significant new instrument supporting industrial technology development with measurable uptake and commitment levels, but narrower in scope than a system-wide R&D funding overhaul.
reforms.source_quote: The new programme for the advancement of industrial technology has been well received by industry and the rate of commitments and outlays has been in accordance with official forecasts.
